items.prompt: Create one self-contained 16:9 editorial HVAC illustration for the MVN Climate Atlas visual system. Clean restrained architectural 3D illustration with precise flat technical overlays, matte materials, warm-white and pale-ice interior, light oak and mist-gray details. Consistent three-quarter isometric camera, 38 mm lens, camera height 1.65 m, slight 10-degree downward angle, vertical lines straight. Soft daylight from upper left at 5200K, gentle short shadows, quiet premium engineering mood. Use the fictional MVN Reference Split 01: matte warm-white indoor unit, visually about 880 by 295 by 210 mm, softly rounded corners, one graphite lower seam and one continuous louver, no logo and no readable display. Calm modern bedroom. The correctly placed unit sits high on the side wall near the headboard and sends exactly three smooth parallel teal airflow lines, #11B8B2, along the room and safely past the bed, with rounded ends and subtle chevrons. A single subtle coral outline on the opposite wall indicates the wrong placement that would blow directly across the bed, with one restrained crossed marker; it is only a ghost outline, not a second physical unit. Include a small deep-teal measurement point near pillow height. Bed in the lower-right area, clean wall space, one light-oak bedside table, neutral mist-gray textiles. Keep all essential content inside the central 85 percent safe area, 2400 by 1350 master composition. No text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, extra air conditioners, confused person, multiple warning icons, collage, split-screen frame, photorealistic stock-photo look, watercolor, flat clipart, glossy advertising render, cyberpunk, dark room, hard shadow, fisheye, clutter, oversized arrows, inconsistent body shape, floating UI, deformed architecture. Single coherent frame, one composed scene or object detail, not a collage, not a grid, not a contact sheet, not a scrapbook, not a mood board layout.

items.prompt: Create one self-contained 16:9 editorial HVAC illustration for the MVN Climate Atlas visual system. Clean restrained architectural 3D illustration with precise flat technical overlays, matte materials, warm-white and pale-ice background. Soft daylight from upper left at 5200K, gentle short shadows, quiet premium engineering mood. Close 70 mm technical cutaway of the same fictional MVN Reference Split 01 used throughout the system: matte warm-white outer body, visually about 880 by 295 by 210 mm, softly rounded corners, one graphite lower seam and one continuous louver, no logo, no readable display. Show credible simplified internal components: evaporator coil, cross-flow fan, drain pan and drain outlet. A light realistic film of dust appears on part of the evaporator and fan, a small amount of moisture sits in the drain pan, and the outlet is partially obstructed. Exactly three smooth parallel teal airflow lines, #11B8B2, enter clean and pass through these internal zones; after the contaminated components they carry only sparse translucent gray-coral particles. Include a small clean serviced section of the same mechanism as a material contrast inside the continuous cutaway, not as a separate panel. One deep-teal engineering bracket identifies the drain area without text. Accurate, restrained, educational and hygienic, not disgusting. Keep all essential content inside the central 85 percent safe area, 2400 by 1350 master composition. items.prompt: One self-contained 16:9 editorial HVAC illustration for the MVN Climate Atlas. Each lane begins independently at the lower louver and ends independently in the open left half of the room. Each is one smooth continuous curve. The lanes never split, fork, duplicate, merge or create a short tail. There are exactly three teal curves anywhere in the image, clearly countable from unit to endpoint. Equal spacing. Teal #11B8B2. Each lane has one small left-pointing chevron integrated at its endpoint, exactly three chevrons. All three lanes stay above and to the left of the sleeping zone, not across the pillows or body. Add one small deep-teal measurement dot near pillow height without a connecting line. Sparse room: bed lower right, one bedside table, one small neutral vase, blank walls. Keep all essential elements in central safe area, 2400 by 1350. No fourth line, no partial line, no branch near the louver, no glow trail, no shadow interpreted as airflow, no text, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no second physical unit, no person, no additional arrows or icons, no collage, no split screen, no watercolor, no flat clipart, no glossy commercial render, no dark mood, no clutter, no floating UI.
